reconciliation.selection_rationale: Earliest Hugging Face commit containing all five required artifacts at sizes exactly matching the AEGIS provider descriptor (model.safetensors=1583355740, option_marker.pt=1581316050, config.json=6349, tokenizer.json=3583485, tokenizer_config.json=599). Artifact sizes verified stable from commit 308feac9c5 through 272b292a05. Commits 3896038655 and later alter model.safetensors size; commits from 5df8185a4f introduce architecture 1.2.0 (independent_options), which is incompatible with the 1.1.0 Option-Marker specification.
reconciliation.removed_artifacts_reason: File does not exist in wfzyx/von repository at any audited commit. Verified offline-compatible: AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained with local_files_only=True operates correctly without this file.
reconciliation.hashes_source: Git LFS pointer sha256 digests extracted from raw LFS pointer blobs at commit 308feac9c53d4080df31b7d81362bffbd086de2d. These are cryptographic SHA-256 digests of the actual file content, not the pointer files.
reconciliation.hashes_verification_note: Hashes extracted from authoritative LFS pointer records. Cannot be independently recalculated until artifacts are downloaded. Full recalculation required post-download before model activation.
reconciliation.resource_gate_reason: Available host RAM headroom (~788 MB) is below the minimum required for safe model resident loading (~3.0 GB). Model provisioning and live inference qualification are deferred. The 1.5 GB system RAM reserve floor is non-negotiable.

compatibility.incompatible_reason: Revision 5df8185a4f introduces architecture 1.2.0 (independent_options field), changing model.safetensors and config.json to incompatible dimensions.
